summary: Strengthen board-level AI risk, accountability and reporting. Explore practical oversight tools for directors and senior executives.
lede: AI oversight training helps board members, non-executive directors and senior executives govern AI, data and digital change. It develops practical ways to clarify decision rights, assess AI risks and escalation routes, and shape board reporting from assurance evidence so leaders can challenge initiatives and connect findings to decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for leaders who govern AI, data and digital change, or who challenge the executives responsible for it. It suits senior decision-makers who need to connect board oversight with risk, assurance and technology reporting.
modules: NIST AI RMF and Board Accountability
EU AI Act and Regulatory Expectations
COSO ERM, IIA Three Lines and Dashboards
prerequisites: Prior experience in board, executive, regulatory or senior public-sector leadership is appropriate. No programming is required; exercises use governance artefacts, board reporting examples and facilitated decision scenarios.
